en-US.name: video-use
en-US.summary: Edit videos and create subtitles/animation overlays conversationally. Transcription sends source audio to ElevenLabs Scribe; an API key is required and usage may incur separate charges. Requires Python 3.10+ and ffmpeg/ffprobe.

zh-CN.name: video-use 视频剪辑
zh-CN.summary: 以对话式工作流剪辑视频并生成字幕、动画叠层；转录会将素材音频发送至 ElevenLabs Scribe，需 API 密钥（可能另收费）；需要 Python 3.10+、ffmpeg/ffprobe。

requirements.value: Python 3.10 or newer with uv or pip; install the dependencies declared by the upstream pyproject.toml.
ffmpeg and ffprobe must be available on PATH; yt-dlp is optional for URL sources.

Transcription sends source audio to ElevenLabs Scribe. Obtain the operator's consent before the first upload. An operator-provided API key is required and separate usage charges may apply; without consent or a key, stop before the external call.
